svg.title: Barangay Health Information System Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Classic table-style entity relationship diagram arranged in three columns. Foreign key fields are highlighted in pale gold, and relationship lines use crow's-foot notation.
svg.text: Entity Relationship Diagram | PK = primary key | FK = foreign key
Circle indicates an optional foreign key
Note: users.citizen_id and events.announcement_id are not database-enforced foreign keys; REFERRALS has no foreign-key relationship.
